I had my first rooftop solar system installed by JWS a few years ago. Reaching out for a quote I found their support staff to be extremely responsive, flexible and particularly knowledgeable - they know solar technology inside and out and can effortlessly discuss with you the merits and drawbacks of different systems, technologies and approaches. Ultimately their quote was very competitive and their level of service and professionalism put them at the top of the list.The install was finished in a day and it's been going without a hitch, set and forget. JWS say they intend to leave your roof in a better condition than they found it, and my experience has suggested that is true.We moved house recently and so it seemed like a no-brainer to at least get another quote from JWS along with the 3 from SolarQuotes. I honestly assumed at their level they'd be charging more, but I suppose the solar business must be pretty cutthroat.I had a lot of random questions about different technologies, brands and negotiating the new Federal battery rebate (before the election, risky!) and JWS were extremely patient and professional about it. In exchanges I had with other installers they seemed to rapidly get frustrated or veer off into making claims about brands and technology they were selling that simply could not be corroborated. JWS never struggled to make their case or substantiate their reasoning.Ultimately JWS became the clear choice again and everything was booked in quickly.Coincidentally, the day JWS came to install ended up being the day my wife gave birth to our second kid, and I could only be back and forth from the site very briefly, or take intermittent calls from them when I could. JWS' installers were very understanding of the situation and worked autonomously. They even identified a significant issue with our electrical connection to the grid, where we had a very out of date, underspecced connection to the powerlines that could have caused breakers to trip or become unsafe if overloaded. Even though I said clearly I did not expect them to fix it, they went out of their way to identify a solution and ensure the whole system was up to spec from end-to-end - for no additional cost.From start to finish JWS seems to be a well-managed outfit run by professional people, and I would happily recommend them to anyone.
